pass_summary: Implementation fully satisfies all 5 correctness gates and 10 Truths. Delete routes through the vector-aware service on every path, update re-indexes the vector (remove-then-index), applyFreshness is a byte-equivalent shared formula, auto-decay is throttled/off-hot-path/skips alreadyRunning, and both shipped rules + embedded assets document the new tools. Only minor doc-completeness nits found.

issues.title: CLI help omits --type and --files flags for `memory update`
issues.description: src/memory/cli.ts runUpdate reads args.flags.type and args.flags.files (mapped to filePaths), but the printed Options help block only lists --title, --content, and --tags. The `update <id>` usage string also only mentions --type/--tags/--content but the top-level Options section is incomplete. Users can't discover --type or --files from `memory` help.
issues.suggested_fix: Add `--type <t>` and `--files <a,b,c>` lines to the Options help block in the CLI usage string so the documented flags match what runUpdate actually parses.

issues.title: runUpdate with an empty patch still resets timestamp+quality
issues.description: src/memory/cli.ts runUpdate builds a patch only from provided flags; if the user passes just an id with no field flags, patch is {} and service.updateObservation still runs store.updateObservation which resets timestamp=now and quality_score=1.0 (a no-op field change that silently refreshes staleness). This is arguably intended (a bare 'touch' to refresh recency) but is undocumented and could surprise a user who fat-fingers the command.
issues.suggested_fix: Either document that `memory update <id>` with no fields intentionally refreshes staleness, or guard: if no field flags are present, return a usage hint instead of silently touching the record.

truths.truth: store.updateObservation(id, patch) changes content AND sets fresh timestamp + quality_score; null on missing id.
truths.evidence: store.ts updateObservation: existence-check returns null; UPDATE sets timestamp=Date.now(), quality_score derived same as insert (confidence-in-[0,1] else 1.0); returns getObservation(id). store.test.ts covers field change, timestamp/quality reset, and null-on-missing.

truths.truth: After update, FTS finds the NEW content and NOT the OLD unique content.
truths.evidence: store.updateObservation deliberately does NOT touch observations_fts, relying on the observations_au AFTER-UPDATE trigger. Plan and store.test.ts assert search-after-update finds new/not-old; suite reported green.

truths.truth: service.updateObservation calls vectorStore.removeObservation(id) then indexObservation(new); deleteObservation removes the vector.
truths.evidence: service.ts:158-178 — after store update, if vectorStore.isAvailable(): removeObservation(id) THEN indexObservation(id,title,content,tags,projectPath,timestamp) (6-arg signature matches addObservation and vector-store.ts:158). deleteObservation (existing) removes vector. service.test.ts uses a removeCalls/indexCalls spy asserting order.

truths.truth: memory_update/memory_delete are snake_case MCP tools working via service AND client; delete routes through the vector-aware service on both.
truths.evidence: mcp-tools.ts registerUpdateDeleteTools registered on both null-client and client branches. Delete: client?client.deleteObservation(id):service.deleteObservation(id). Sidecar routes.ts handleMemoryDelete calls ctx.service.deleteObservation (comment: 'removes the vector embedding, not just the FTS row'). No raw store.deleteObservation on any path.

truths.truth: sentinal memory update <id> --content X and memory delete <id> mutate through the service.
truths.evidence: cli.ts runUpdate calls service.updateObservation; runDelete calls service.deleteObservation. Dispatch cases 'update'/'delete' wired. cli.test.ts covers these paths.

truths.truth: sentinal-memory.md (both targets) instructs preferring memory_update over a new correction; EMBEDDED_RULES + EMBEDDED_CC_RULES reflect it.
truths.evidence: Both targets/opencode and targets/claude-code sentinal-memory.md contain memory_update/memory_delete table rows and the 'Correct in place — don't stack corrections' guidance. rules-memory-refs.test.ts asserts both shipped files AND the dynamically-imported EMBEDDED_RULES/EMBEDDED_CC_RULES contain memory_update; embed guard reported passing.

truths.truth: Auto-decay runs when last-decay.json is missing/older-than-threshold, skips when fresh; startSidecar calls it best-effort without crashing.
truths.evidence: auto-decay.ts runAutoDecayIfStale: readLastDecay returns null on missing/corrupt (=stale=run); throttle gate now-lastDecay<thresholdMs skips; whole body in try/catch returning {ran:false} on any error. server.ts scheduleStartupDecay defers via queueMicrotask in its own try/catch. Injectable now/thresholdMs/stateFile for tests; SENTINAL_LAST_DECAY_PATH override for isolation.

truths.truth: sentinal memory decay and maintain decay|prune|stats exist and work; maintain prune is dry-run by default, only deletes with --apply.
truths.evidence: cli.ts runDecay and runMaintain (switch decay|stats|prune). runMaintain prune: apply=args.flags.apply==='true'; without --apply it COUNTs candidates and returns a dry-run message, only calling service.prune when --apply is set. Dispatch cases 'decay'/'maintain' wired; help text documents both.

truths.truth: Shared applyFreshness (recency-add-then-quality-multiply, now injectable) is the single formula: hybrid uses it, searchFtsOnly over-fetches+re-ranks, store.searchFTS is NOT freshness-weighted, explicit date ordering passes through.
truths.evidence: freshness.ts applyFreshness = (base + recencyBoost) * max(quality,0.1) — byte-equivalent to old hybrid math. hybrid.ts refactored to call it (inline math + local MAX_RECENCY_BOOST removed). service.searchFtsOnly: orderBy!=='relevance' passes through via ftsFetch untouched; relevance mode over-fetches max(limit*5,50) offset:0, applies applyFreshness on positional base (1-index*0.05), sorts, slices to offset+limit. Re-rank lives ONLY in service, not store.searchFTS (shared by hybrid FTSStrategy — no double-apply). service.test.ts covers the past-the-limit surfacing and date_desc passthrough.

truths.truth: bun test green; bunx tsc --noEmit clean; check-embed-assets passes.
truths.evidence: Orchestrator reports 1751 pass / 0 fail, tsc 0 errors, embed guard passes. New test files present for store, service, mcp-tools, cli, routes, server, auto-decay, freshness, and rules-memory-refs.
